title: flv action
description: Converts a flat file of fixed-length values into XML: <flv-message> holds a <rule> for every rule and a <segment> for every line, which a rule cuts into its fields by their length, from the start of the line. The first rule whose matchOn the line starts with is used; a line no rule matches is left out. The line of a group rule starts a <group>, which holds the segments of the lines that follow up to the next group. The rules are the option rules, or an option per rule: its name is matchOn (or _group_ and matchOn for a group rule) and its value the fields, such as header[3]body[5].

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: JSON list of rules, in the order they are tried: {"matchOn": "HDR", "group": false, "subcollection": [{"field": "header", "length": 3}, ...]}. A flow's DIL rules list is passed as this text
